Experience

We bring in the best leaders to teach you how to be the best.

Vivint Smart Home Pros

Job Description
What do we do?
The honest version.
We sacrifice our summer and relocate to another state for 4 months, knocking door to door selling smart home security.
01
100% commission.
And it’s hard. There’s no hourly safety net. Your paycheck is exactly what you make happen.
02
Every condition.
We knock when it’s cold, we knock when it’s hot, and we knock when it’s dark.
03
Rejection, daily.
We hear no every single day, and at times it seems like everything that could go wrong does.
04
Worth every door.
We have fun, we grow exponentially, and we make a lot of money doing it.
Keys to Success
Follow these 5 keys.
Success is guaranteed.
1
Stay positive
Attitude is the one thing you control at every door. Bring the same energy to the hundredth door as the first.
2
Work all the hours
The reps at the top aren’t luckier. They’re the ones still knocking when everyone else calls it a night.
3
Don’t give up
Summers are won in the weeks you want to quit. Push through and the results compound.
4
Be coachable
Take the feedback and use it the same day. The reps who grow fastest are the ones who listen.
5
Don’t reinvent the wheel
The system already works. Master what’s proven before you try to improve on it.
Growth
Unlock a version of you
you never knew existed.
Sales & persuasion
Every career is sales. Learn to lead any conversation to a yes.
Communication
Talk to hundreds of strangers a week. Public speaking and tough conversations get easy.
Leadership
Train new reps and build a team. Real leadership experience for your résumé.
Discipline
Nobody clocks you in. Learn to stay self-motivated without a boss watching.
Resilience
Hear no all day, do hard things and stop letting fear make your decisions.
Problem solving
Every door is different. Learn to think on your feet and find a way.
Financial freedom
Earn big, then learn to budget, save and invest years before your peers.
The right people
Surround yourself with people who push you to become your best.
Environment
You’re the average of
the people around you.
We’re people from all over the country, from different backgrounds, united by a common cause. Surround yourself with goal-oriented, highly motivated people every day, and their standard becomes yours.
From all over the countryDifferent backgroundsOne common cause
Travel
20 weeks away.
A whole new world.
Every summer we leave home and move to a new market: a new state, a new city, new neighborhoods. You’ll immerse yourself in cultures and environments you’d never experience sitting at home.
01
New cultures
Learn how people live, talk and think in a part of the country you’ve never seen.
02
New environments
Mountains, suburbs, coastlines. Every market teaches you to adapt fast.
03
New family
You live, work and explore with a team that becomes your closest friends.

Stories for life
1519
Relocation
Burn the ships.
There’s no going back.
In 1519, Hernán Cortés landed on the coast of Mexico and ordered his own ships destroyed. With no way home, his men had one direction left: forward. Relocating for the summer works the same way. Leave the comfort of home behind, and the only thing left to do is win.
Lock in
A new city, a new routine and one focus. Every day is built around the job.
Cut the noise
No old friends pulling you out, no weekend plans, no comfort zone to slip back into.
No plan B
When going home isn’t an option, you find a way to make it work. That’s when reps break out.
